-- Awards: ● 2021 BitSummit THE 8th BIT: Official Selection ● Busan Indie Connect 2020: Excellence in Casual ● Bahamut 2020 ACG Creation Contest: Bronze Award About: Dungeon and Puzzles is a game that challenges players' 2D spatial perception and logical thinking. A player can use a sword to attack monsters, or a bow and an arrow to destroy enemies from afar. Pushing the obstacles back with a shield and pulling the monsters with a pair of special gloves. There are 150 handcrafted rooms in the dungeon. Players will have to get a better understanding of the game to solve the puzzles and clear the rooms. To beat the puzzles with fewer moves, achieving advanced goals, players will have to try different tactics and move combinations to find an optimized solution for the room. AlpinePRO is an advanced outdoor navigation, terrain analysis, route planning, and team coordination application designed for hiking, exploration, field operations, search activities, and professional outdoor use. Navigate with detailed 2D maps, interactive 3D terrain, precise coordinate tools, offline map support, targets, routes, tracks, and real-time team features. 2D AND 3D MAPS • Explore detailed 2D maps and realistic 3D terrain • View elevation and analyze mountains, valleys, and surrounding landforms • Use satellite, hybrid, topographic, relief, trail, tactical, and other supported layers • Display MGRS grid lines with real 1 × 1 km squares • Preserve the selected map position between screens and fullscreen mode OFFLINE MAPS • Automatically cache viewed map areas • Download supported 3D regions for offline use • Select 5 km, 10 km, 25 km, or 50 km download areas • Monitor download progress and storage usage • Import supported offline maps, including MBTiles COORDINATE TOOLS • View MGRS, UTM, latitude/longitude, DMS, DDM, and other formats • Search by entering coordinates • Copy, share, and convert coordinates • Select exact positions using the map-center marker TARGETS, ROUTES, AND TRACKS • Create named targets and map markers • Add numbered route points from the map center • Organize targets and route points into groups • Build routes by connecting multiple points • Add names and notes to route points • Record GPS tracks and review distance, duration, speed, elevation, and points • Export supported geographic data formats NAVIGATION AND COMPASS • Navigate to targets, route points, and team members • View heading, bearing, distance, speed, and estimated arrival time • Use integrated compass and map navigation modes • Receive configurable destination-distance alerts • Access augmented reality navigation on supported devices TEAM ROOM • Create a private team or join using a session code • Share your live location when you choose • View participating members on the map with individual colors and names • View shared battery status and location information • Send messages, images, and supported field packages • Assign roles and manage members as the team owner • Temporarily mute team notifications TEAM NOTIFICATIONS Send notifications to members of the active team: • Emergency Help • Attention • Order • Under Attack • Custom Notification Location sharing and team communication require the appropriate permissions and an internet connection. FIELD PACKAGES • Create and share AlpinePRO field packages • Store targets, routes, route points, notes, and supported content in an .aqpmap file • Preview package contents before importing • Merge imported information with existing data • Share prepared field information with other AlpinePRO users ADDITIONAL TOOLS • GPS photo geotagging • Distance and area calculations • Sun and moon information • Elevation and terrain information • Measurement, drawing, and marked-area tools • Light, dark, and tactical themes • Multiple language support PRIVACY Live location sharing remains disabled until the user enables it and can be stopped at any time. Team information is available only within the active team according to its access controls. IMPORTANT NOTICE AlpinePRO is a navigation and planning aid. GPS, compass, map, elevation, weather, coordinate, and arrival-time information may be affected by device sensors, environmental conditions, third-party data, or network availability. Verify critical information using official sources and appropriate professional equipment. AlpinePRO does not replace official emergency services. Contact the appropriate local emergency authority in an emergency whenever possible.

Application Description

RadarScope is an AMS-award-winning weather visualization tool that empowers meteorologists, public safety officials, storm spotters, and weather enthusiasts to view a full suite of single-site radar data and related severe weather products. Your initial purchase provides professional radar visualization in a fully native app, free from distracting and invasive practices, with optional subscription packages to add even more capabilities. Whether you’re scanning for a mesocyclone’s tell-tale hook echo, pinpointing the landfall of a hurricane’s eye wall, or identifying velocity couplet, hail spike, or debris ball signatures, RadarScope displays native radar data in its original radial format. You see what the radar sees almost as soon as the radar sees it, with automatic updates every two to ten minutes depending on the radar’s scanning strategy. Your initial app purchase includes the following: • Full suite of single-site radar products for the US, Canada, Guam, Denmark, Finland, and Germany • 6-frame radar loops • Two built-in providers for radar data • Tornado, thunderstorm, flash flood, marine, snow squall, extreme wind, tropical, and other warnings in the US • Selected severe weather warnings in Canada and Australia • NWS-generated storm tracks with hail, TVS, and mesocyclone attributes • Inspector and distance tools • Color palette options for radar data • Weather Pulse data plan integration • Spotter Network integration for storm and location reporting • mPING integration for submitting weather reports to NSSL • Bundled maps with political boundaries, water bodies, and major highways, optimized for low-bandwidth use • Support for widgets and complications • Universal app for Apple platforms, including Apple Watch and Apple TV • Family Sharing support RadarScope Pro Tier One is an optional annual subscription that adds more features for tracking severe weather: • 30-frame radar loops • Cloud-to-ground lightning strikes • Severe weather watches in the US and Canada • Special weather statements in the US and Canada • Mesoscale convective and precipitation discussions • SPC convective, tornado, hail, wind, and fire outlooks • WPC excessive rainfall outlooks in the US • Local storm reports in the US • Custom color palette support • Multi-pane display (2 on phones; 4 on larger devices) • Family Sharing support RadarScope Pro Tier Two is an optional annual or monthly subscription that transforms RadarScope into a more complete visualization tool for a larger suite of weather products, including: • Everything in Pro Tier One • 50-frame radar loops • A third provider for US radar data • 30-year archive of NEXRAD Level II radar data • 6-year archive of NEXRAD Level III data • 30-day archive of super-res and non-US radar data • 20-year archive of NWS bulletins • GOES satellite data • Multi-Radar Multi-Sensor (MRMS) data • Real-Time Mesoscale Assimilation (RTMA) data • GFS, ECMWF, HRRR, HRW, and NAM forecast model data • Surface observations • Atmospheric soundings in the US • Hail size, hail probability, and azimuthal shear contours with a 30-day archive • More detailed transportation and satellite imagery maps • Custom color palette support for GOES, MRMS, RTMA, and forecast products • Server-sent events for radar and warning updates • Cross-platform subscription sharing on up to 5 devices • Family sharing support If you choose to buy a RadarScope Pro subscription, it will be charged to your App Store account. The subscription will be auto-renewed within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the same price you originally paid. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal disabled via your App Store account settings after the purchase. Once purchased, the subscription cannot be canceled during the active subscription period. DTN is committed to safeguarding your privacy online. Our privacy policy is available for review at https://www.dtn.com/privacy-policy/ Please visit our web site for more information.

Hear My Baby uses your iPhone microphone to help you listen to baby heart sounds. HMB 2.0 adds AI chat support, tailored tutorials, and pregnancy reveal videos (+ your heartbeat) to help you get results faster, and is now free to download. Why parents choose Hear My Baby Heartbeat App - Hear your baby’s heartbeat using the iPhone’s built-in microphone — no accessories required - AI chat support provides step-by-step help with setup, positioning and recording conditions - Enhances low-frequency audio captured by the iPhone microphone to help users listen for and save special pregnancy sounds. - Tailored tutorial adapts to your stage of pregnancy and setup - Create baby sex reveal videos (+ your heartbeat) to share the moment - Record & save clips; build a personal timeline you can revisit - Share easily with family and friends (Instagram, WhatsApp, email) - Designed by parents with expertise in sound engineering, AI and app development; warm, honest guidance throughout - Privacy first — you control what’s saved and shared Real 5 Star Reviews "I never leave reviews, let along pay for apps but let’s just say I tried this , and it def works" - Lov3r_Gurl IG (USA Sept 2025) “I always find 'it' (sic) eventually and the rhythm is clear and strong. I love that I can record them to keep.” - T Lucker (Australia 2025) "I downloaded this very skeptical... It took me about 45 minutes of laying down, very still, with noise canceling headphones on, but I HEARD IT. I am almost 18 weeks pregnant. From one momma to the next, it’s worth it." - Baby'sHeartbeat (2025) “It took some time and patience... thank you for creating this cheap, awesome technology to use at home.” — Niki “I was skeptical at first. Great app! Worth it.” — Legretta How it works - Hear My Baby uses your iPhone’s microphone to listen for abdominal sounds; it is not a doppler and doesn’t emit ultrasound. It’s a lifestyle keepsake for bonding and sharing, not a medical device and not for diagnosis. - Our advanced audio engine isolates and amplifies fetal heartbeat sounds so you can listen and save the recording, and trim it to the appropriate moment for sharing quickly and easily. - Best from around 16+ weeks; clearest for many families at ~27 weeks. Results vary with baby’s position and placenta location. Tips for best results - Be still, breathe lightly, and try several positions around your bump - Press the mic firmly against the skin; explore low and to the sides - Bluetooth/over-ear headphones can make subtle sounds easier to hear Important Hear My Baby is not a medical device and doesn’t replace prenatal care. If you’re concerned about anything in your pregnancy, please consult your clinician. Seek a doctor’s advice if you have any concerns. You can switch to Airplane Mode while using the app. Privacy Your moments are yours. You decide what to keep or delete — and who gets to hear them.
